type: qemu
description: Linux
name: Linux
cpulimit: 1
icon: Server-2D-Linux-S.svg
cpu: 2
ram: 4096
ethernet: 1
console: vnc
shutdown: 1
qemu_arch: x86_64
qemu_version: 2.12.0
qemu_nic: virtio-net-pci
qemu_options: -machine type=pc,accel=kvm -vga std -usbdevice tablet -boot order=cd -cpu host
...
